device.description: Quad 12-bit voltage-output DAC with 12-bit parallel interface, read-back, LDAC and reset to mid scale
device.note: dac7725.pdf (SBAS112) p.2-3 electrical characteristics (VDD 4.75-5.25 V, TTL-compatible CMOS logic), p.3 absolute maximum, p.4 pin configurations (SO-28, PLCC-28) and pin descriptions, p.13 digital interface and control logic truth table (Table I), input coding (straight binary), p.14 digital timing (Figure 4, Table II)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: input register A (Table I: A1 A0 = 00); RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: input register B (Table I: A1 A0 = 01); RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: input register C (Table I: A1 A0 = 10); RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: input register D (Table I: A1 A0 = 11); RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC register A; RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC register B; RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC register C; RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC register D; RESET loads 800H (mid scale)

commands.name: Write input register (CS low, R/W low)
commands.note: Table I: the input register A1 A0 select is transparent while CS and R/W are low and latches at CS rising

protocol.note: Table I: CS low with R/W high reads back the selected input register on DB11-DB0 (tCSD 160 ns max, tDZ 100 ns max)

pages: p.2-3 (electrical, logic levels, abs max), p.4 (pinouts, pin descriptions), p.13 (Table I, coding), p.14 (Figure 4, Table II timing)
notModeled: analog: outputs, VREFH/VREFL references, single (+15 V) or dual (+-15 V) analog supplies
power-on state is not specified; registers start at the RESET code 800H (mid scale)
the input register is transparent (follows the data bus) while CS and R/W are low; modeled as latched at CS rising
PLCC-28 (FN) package: not in the skeleton's orderable parts
variants: DAC7724 (RESET to 800H) and DAC7725 (RESET to 000H) share dac7725.pdf with the same pinout and interface; DAC7725 has its own spec. N/U and NB/UB are linearity grades
